title: Yummy Silky Spanish Sloe-beries Dumplings
description: A comforting Spanish dish featuring sour sloe-berries and silky dumplings, originating from the Galicia region. Perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Combine 1 cup of sloe-berries and 2 tablespoons of sugar in a saucepan. Heat the mixture over medium heat until the berries start to release their juice.
In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of flour, 1 egg, 1/2 cup of milk, and a pinch of salt. Mix the dough until it comes together.
Add 1/4 cup of chopped fresh parsley and 1/4 cup of chopped fresh thyme to the dough. Mix well.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a large skillet with 2 tablespoons of pork fat or vegetable oil over medium heat. Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings with the sloe-berry sauce and a sprinkle of Galician cheese.
If desired, add 1/4 cup of white wine to the sloe-berry sauce and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
Optional: serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a salad.
